whatWasTried: Collected 5235 unique PMIDs whose affiliation field already contains Peking University Third Hospital plus a mailbox domain (bjmu.edu.cn, 163.com, 126.com, sina.com, qq.com, yeah.net, vip.163.com, foxmail.com, hotmail.com, 139.com, aliyun.com).

First pass assigned an address when it sat anywhere in one author's affiliation. That falsely paired 伍蕊 (呼吸与危重症医学科) with pathology author Rui Wu's raynwu98@163.com (PMID 30173944). The matcher was stopped and tightened to require a positive department keyword.
Strict department matching still returned six hits. Every address belonged to the corresponding author and had been pasted onto another author node. None were published.
Explicit 'Corresponding author: Name, Email' extraction found 34 phrases and zero missing directory doctors.
Full-pinyin coauthor matching found one candidate, 孟灵梅 menglingmei1977@163.com (PMID 26710953). The address is on 周丽雅's affiliation line, not 孟灵梅's node. Rejected.
LetPub and the NSFC portal returned JavaScript shells. CQVIP returned HTTP 412. WJG returned HTTP 403. Those walls were not bypassed.

《中国微创外科杂志》 prints *通讯作者，E-mail in article HTML. Its unit search for 北京大学第三医院 returned two articles. 15910776454@163.com on 201903004 belongs to 姜玲 (老年内科, already owned), not 张福春 (心血管内科, still missing). Issue-index URLs do not paginate.

rule: An address is accepted only when it is inside the target doctor's own author node, or an explicit corresponding-author line names that doctor, and the hospital plus department match the directory. Username similarity and same-hospital coauthorship are not enough. PubMed Chinese-journal records routinely paste the correspondent's mailbox onto the first author or a senior coauthor.
